description: Connect your own Emby server account and sync watched and in-progress state, playback positions and play counts into Movies, TV and Anime, with a Watch in Emby link.
name: Emby Media Sync

permissions.rationale: Create or enrich your own Movies, TV and Anime records from your Emby libraries, with watch state, progress, play counts and a 'Watch in Emby' link. Local edits and ambiguous matches go to review.
Sign in to and read your Emby server with your own user session. Reads only, plus sign-out on disconnect; redirects are refused.
Keep your Emby credential, connection, library choices, sync checkpoint and review queue in this plugin's private storage.
Run your opt-in personal Emby autosync and Connections → Sync now on the server, one bounded step at a time.
List Emby on Settings → Account → Connections with its connection status and Sync now.

scheduled_tasks.description: Sync your connected Emby libraries. Each run advances one bounded checkpoint and continues until the census is complete; local notes, ratings and edits are preserved.
scheduled_tasks.name: Emby autosync
